paragraphs.text: Yaraghiya was a vedalken nurse in the service of the League of Wojek , the head of the Tenth Leaguehall 's infirmary.
Her voice was melodic and smooth, but she almost always spoke in an ice-cold and annoyed tone. She was very strict and stern.
Yaraghiya was responsible for Agrus Kos 's curative process after the bombing assassination attempt at Saint Bayul .
The wojeks repaid her coldness with the less-than-charming nickname " Argh ".
